get.description:
Returns all Drip Campaigns on your account.

> Drip Campaigns must be created or modified in the Portal.

Drip Campaigns have a list of Drip Campaign Steps, which are represented using a linked list. Each step points to the next step in the list, with the last step having a `null` next step ID.

Recipients are attached to a step and will be sent the Order for that Step after a specified number of days, then advance to the next Step. After reaching the last order, they are removed from the Drip Campaign and will no longer receive orders.

post.description:
Places an Order using a pre-configured Webhook.

Order placement webhooks use pre-filled data to place orders more easily. Instead of specifying generic Order data, such as design information and mailing settings, this route only needs recipient information, the webhook id, and an api key.

To create these webhooks, go to the "Incoming" tab on the Webhooks page in the PCMI Portal and press the "New Webhook" button. From there, use the form to create a new order placement webhook and provide all necessary data.

Recipient addressing information and design variables are specified using either query parameters or a JSON body. For example, these two requests are handled the same way.

<!--
type: tab
title: Body
-->

```json
{
  "method": "POST",
  "url": "/order/webhook/123",
  "body": {
    "apiKey": 456,
    "firstName": "Alex",
    "myVar": "foo",
    ...
  }
}
```

<!--
type: tab
title: Query Parameters
-->

```json
{
  "method": "POST",
  "url": "/order/webhook/123?apiKey=456&firstName=Alex&myVar=foo&..."
}
```

<!-- type: tab-end -->

If you created your webhook using a dynamic url, you must provide the following information depending on the webhook's product type.

| Product Type  | Fields          |
| ------------- | --------------- |
| Postcard      | `front`, `back` |
| Letter        | `letter`        |
| Brochure      | `brochure`      |
| Greeting Card | `greetingCard`  |
| Snap Apart    | `letter`        |

> This route is not authenticated like other routes. Instead of passing an authorization header with a token, provide an api key using the `apiKey` query parameter or body JSON key. You can find these keys on the My Account page in the PCM Integrations Portal.
